name: Spatial Integration as Navigational Prediction and the Configuration of Wayfinding PE
short_description: Space Syntax integration determines cognitive map reliability; intelligibility determines visual-global prediction accuracy; navigational PE follows Goldilocks zone
structural_pattern: Spatial configuration determines the structure and reliability of the brain's cognitive map (hippocampal place cell ensembles, entorhinal grid cells, border cells). Space Syntax integration — the measure of how topologically connected a space is to all other spaces — operationalizes navigational predictability: high-integration spaces are those the brain can predict reaching from many starting points via few direction changes. Movement through a building follows lines of maximum integration because this minimizes navigational PE. Moderate integration → confident wayfinding → positive affect; very high integration → oversimplified → boredom; low integration → high navigational PE → stress, disorientation. Intelligibility (correlation between local visual connectivity and global integration) determines how well visual predictions match global structure.
higher_order_principle: The navigational instantiation of the Goldilocks zone. Too little spatial complexity → no navigational prediction, no engagement. Moderate complexity with high intelligibility → confident wayfinding with active cognitive map engagement → spatial pleasure. Excessive complexity with low intelligibility → navigational PE exceeds cognitive map capacity → T14 navigational stress.

space_syntax_metrics.integration: Topological connectivity to all other spaces — predicts movement density
space_syntax_metrics.intelligibility: Correlation between local connectivity and global integration — predicts cognitive map accuracy
space_syntax_metrics.depth: Number of turns required to reach from integration core — predicts navigational difficulty

vertical_pe_hierarchy.elevators: Maximum spatial discontinuity — highest vertical PE
vertical_pe_hierarchy.stairs: Intermittent spatial sampling — moderate vertical PE
vertical_pe_hierarchy.ramps: Continuous path integration — lowest vertical PE

causal_links.evidence_base: High-integration spaces activate reliable, distinct place cell ensembles because they are reached by many convergent routes. Space Syntax integration predicts movement density (Hillier, 1996).
High intelligibility means visual local information accurately predicts global position → confident cognitive map → low PE. (Dalton, 2003)
Distinctive sensory features at decision points anchor the cognitive map. Wayfinding errors cluster at landmark-poor decision points. (Hölscher et al., 2006)
Grid cells degrade in vertical dimension (Hayman et al., 2011). Elevators completely remove navigator from spatial network → maximum coordinate disruption.
Low PE → spatial confidence → positive affect. Moderate PE → spatial engagement → interest. High PE (without agency) → T14 navigational stress → anxiety.

scope_conditions: Applies to all buildings with non-trivial spatial configuration — multiple rooms, corridors, levels, or choice points
Effect is strongest for first-time visitors navigating without signage; reduces with familiarity
Signage and digital wayfinding reduce navigational PE independently of spatial configuration
Culture and experience modulate baseline expectations
moderators: Familiarity: repeated visits build the cognitive map and reduce PE
Spatial ability: individual differences in spatial cognition modulate PE magnitude
Signage: reduces PE independently of spatial configuration
Agency: chosen vs. forced navigation modulates emotional response
Age: hippocampal decline increases navigational PE in elderly populations

interactions.nature: T14 describes stress response to navigational failure. SC1 specifies spatial conditions that produce the PE that T14 responds to.
T3 describes cognitive map formation. SC1 specifies how spatial configuration determines the quality of that map.
Low integration and low intelligibility increase spatial uncertainty → may activate T5 threat pathway.
Complex, low-intelligibility configurations tax directed attention → T25 attention fatigue.
